name: prisma-postgres-setup
description: Obtain or reuse a Prisma Postgres database and connect an application. Use when the user needs a database and has none configured ("I need a database", "add a Postgres database", "set up a database for this app"), is about to deploy, host, publish or share an app that has no hosted database yet ("deploy my app", "put it online", "share it with a friend"), runs or mentions `create-db` or `npx create-db`, or asks to set up or connect Prisma Postgres, including in v0 and the Vercel Marketplace. Han
author: prisma
